uncited: **Address Calculation:** Calculate the eight memory addresses for the trilinear neighborhood.
**Buffering and Fetching:** Addresses are pushed into the FIFO buffers of the respective memory modules.
Voxel values are fetched from the SDRAMs.

*   **Sub-cube Boundary Crossing:** When a ray crosses the y-z plane of the next $s^3$ sub-cube, memories $M_0, M_2, M_4, M_6$ change coordinates and refresh their cache, while $M_1, M_3, M_5, M_7$ remain in the current sub-cube.
*   **Cache Misses:** Without buffering, frame time depends on the sum of the slowest SDRAM access at every read of a trilinear neighborhood.
